title: Validity CNF Characterizes Configuration Codes
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $n,s$ be natural numbers. For every Boolean word $w$ of length equal to the codec width for $M,n,s$, the validity CNF evaluates to true under the assignment that gives variable $v$ the bit of $w$ at position $v$ (and gives false when that position is outside $w$) if and only if there are a Boolean input word $x$ of length $n$ and a configuration $c$ of $M$ on input $x$ such that every work-tape head lies within distance $s$ of the origin, every work-tape cell outside that interval is blank, and $w$ is the configuration code of $x,c$ for parameters $n,s$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$w$ has length equal to the codec width for $M,n,s$
